data.description:
Spike: write docs/EXTENSIONS.md, the playbook for the requirements the interviewer is likely to add live. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §9. Design hooks: BRANDING.md §5 ("where a new requirement goes" notes in each component) and §10.

Why: the live session is explicitly about extending a design already built, narrating the reasoning. A rehearsed playbook with the exact seams turns a surprise into a demo. This is also where the owner rehearses before the session.

Scope (docs/EXTENSIONS.md):
- One entry per §9 item: the requirement in one line; the exact files and functions to touch (verified to exist by grep at writing time); the API change (params, response fields) and the UI change (which BRANDING §5 slot); the tests to add; a minutes estimate. Keep each entry under 25 lines.
- A rehearsal section working three of them through as mini-plans the owner can narrate aloud: cross-source dedupe (stage in the §6 pipeline, key choice, which record wins, the `2 sources` meta item), geo radius (bounding box in SQL, haversine in Go, two new params and validation), sort options (one change in domain ordering, a select in the status line per BRANDING §5.7's precedent).
- A short "what I would say" paragraph for the two trade-offs most likely to be questioned: scoring weights and SQL-versus-Go ranking.

Acceptance:
- Every referenced symbol exists in the code (a reviewer greps each one).
- Plain product voice, no emoji, under 300 lines.

Validation: N/A (documentation). Record a one-line justification with --role validation.
data.title: Extension playbook: how each likely live-session requirement lands (docs/EXTENSIONS.md)

data.body: Plan-review triage (art_01M4WCKXJV38BKNP5MAJCS9MBY, fable PASS-WITH-NITS): 6 findings, all obvious, amended in the plan's Cycle 1 Resolutions block (asOf pin for order and A1 score; POSIX [[:space:]] in grep line 36; master merged before implementation so the block runs once at HEAD 0b24829; tighter per-section line targets; precompute-the-inputs phrasing; validator eyeballs voice-grep hits in code). No evolutionary or complex findings. BC-12 and BC-6 landed; branch fast-forwarded to master 0b24829.

Review cycle 1 routing (art_01M4WDRNDWH1M3J2MZYAKY4Q5R, fable PASS-WITH-NITS @ f4b6c77): Minor price-sort ranks basis -> fix; Nit 0002 index wording -> fix; Nit filterKey wording -> fix; Nit asOf backticks -> fix; process nit (symbol table lacks Upsert/SearchFilter.Statuses lines) -> fixed by delegator in the plan's Review Cycle 1 Findings block. Status stays review; implementer sub-agent applies the four doc nits, then fresh fable re-review on the new HEAD (fix->re-review cycle 1 of 2).

Review cycle 2 routing (fable PASS @ 3fc1aa4): all 4 cycle-1 findings confirmed fixed. Skipping Nit line 10 (Store.Search vs Searcher.Search): reviewer marks it optional and not wrong (Store implements Searcher, named at line 171); another commit would force a third review for no reader benefit. Two informational nits (length under soft target; master moved to c8837b5 with BC-15 README/.lattice only) need no action. Not merging c8837b5 now: it touches no file this branch has or consumes, so per the landing re-review rule the Orchestrator's landing merge + gate suffices and HEAD stays the reviewed 3fc1aa4.

Completion (delegator): built docs/EXTENSIONS.md (221 lines, commits f4b6c77 + 3fc1aa4): one entry per SPEC §9 item (Requirement/Touch/API/UI/Tests/Estimate, 12-14 lines each), a shared param and response-field checklist, rehearsal mini-plans for cross-source dedupe, geo radius and sort, and What I would say on scoring weights and SQL versus Go ranking. Every named symbol grepped on HEAD and master c8837b5 (validation art_01M4WESGCGK6X6QP4Q4DWYFFN5). Reviews: plan PASS-WITH-NITS (6 obvious, amended), code f4b6c77 PASS-WITH-NITS (4 doc nits fixed in 3fc1aa4, 1 process nit fixed in the plan), code 3fc1aa4 PASS (1 optional nit skipped with reason). No SPEC edits. Findings recorded in the doc for the owner, no tickets created: BRANDING §5.2 'seventh field' is stale (Status is seventh); SPEC §9.1 address+zip dedupe key misses A2/B8 and lacks Ct/Court; ticket says geo adds two params, SPEC §9.3 names three (doc follows SPEC); BRANDING has no sort slot (doc uses the §5.7 page-size precedent). Implementer deviations accepted by review: index claims corrected against migration 0001 (no lat/lng index; price already indexed; keyword uses instr). Gate green on 3fc1aa4.
